objective: Test whether keeping interval 8 early and permitting interval 10 or 12 later can recover speed without exceeding the frozen automatic semantic-quality contract.

known-case_sentinel.reason: Eight samples are insufficient to lower the one-sided 95% failure-rate bound below 10%.

failed_requests: a stained-glass artisan assembling colored pieces into a circular window
two firefighters rescuing a cat from a balcony using a ladder

opened-case_regression.result: Moving the acceleration start from 30% to 40% or 50% did not repair both failures. Tightening the error thresholds repaired the stained-glass request but not the firefighter request. Reducing the maximum interval to 8, 7, or 6 also did not repair the firefighter VQAScore failure.

firefighter_seed_audit.result: The paired VQAScore failure was seed-dependent; seeds 1 through 7 passed. The cached seed-0 image improved ImageReward while VQAScore fell.

firefighter_signal_audit.result: The current global anchor-error signal did not identify the semantic failure. It is not qualified to increase cache intensity or to serve as a per-request semantic guarantee.

second_fresh_audit.registration_note: The prompt file and candidates were committed before execution, but this split was not added to the contract allowlist before execution. Treat this as a frozen independent audit, not as a contract-registered holdout.

shared_failed_request.prompt: a pastry chef stacking cream puffs into a tall cone decorated with thin caramel threads
shared_failed_request.diagnostic_visual_observation: All three images contain the pastry chef, a tall cream-puff cone, and caramel decoration. The cached variants show weaker thin caramel threads. This observation did not override the automatic gate.

brake_only.qualification: This pools one contract-registered 32-request holdout with one independently frozen 32-request audit. Report the registration distinction with the number.

decision.next_action: Keep maximum interval 8 and acceleration disabled as the conservative candidate. Do not tune on the opened failures. Future acceleration work requires a different predictor or a demonstrably earlier request-specific signal, followed by a newly registered holdout.
